## Triage: p2 · `target:v18` · `area:access` · `domain:cli` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-17T23:52Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Fresh read on `origin/main` `6e43b7bc3f`:** `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` `registerActionRoutes` (`:1879`) still mounts the `/actions` paths with `server!.post(…)` only. Every other verb reaches the adapter's unmatched answer (405) before the domain's anonymous baseline runs.
- **Grade p2 + `target:v18`,** the same as its family #23909 and #24024 (both p2, `target:v18`, `area:access`, closed). It is the ADR-0138 D2 floor on one more domain. An anonymous caller learns the route's shape, not data, so it is not `security`.
- **One card, two members, as the card argues:** the `/actions` floor, and an `Allow` that lists refusal-only mounts. A fix copying #23909's mounts would widen the second.
  - The `Allow` half is settled in this lane by not listing refusal-only verbs.
  - ⛔ The `IHttpServer` contract line is not edited unless the claim shows the adapter cannot tell refusal-only mounts apart. That route goes to `domain:spec` first.
- **Serial:** cleared. PR #24227 (#24023) merged at 23:50Z, and its signed-in `405` + `Allow: POST` pin is the control.
- **Scope = the card's Done when,** pinned on a real socket. The unmeasured `/notifications` and `/mcp/skill` faces are measured in the same round.

  - `registerActionRoutes` (about `:1879`–`:1925`, the three `server!.post(…)` `/actions` mounts);

- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`: the registered-method tracking and `unmatchedResponse` (about `:553`, `:1223`, `:1369`), only if the `Allow` half lands in the adapter.
- Pins on a real socket, in the existing runtime or `plugin-hono-server` test files where they fit.
- One `patch` changeset per package whose published behaviour moves.
- ⛔ Hold-offs:
  - `packages/spec/src/contracts/http-server.ts` and every other `packages/spec` path. Triage `6243379401`: the contract line is not edited unless the claim shows the adapter cannot tell refusal-only mounts apart; that route goes to `domain:spec` first, and the dev stops and reports it;
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts` (read only: its anonymous baseline is already the first statement);
  - the 20 `dispatcher.dispatch(… req.body …)` sites of #24151 (serial, below);
  - `readGatedSessionUser` (about `:210`, PR #24232).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: every request whose answer changes is refused before and after. An anonymous non-`POST` to `/actions` moves from the adapter's `405` to the domain's `401`, and a refusal-only verb leaves `Allow`. No verb is admitted that was refused, and no accept set or export widens.
Responsibility: `packages/runtime`'s standalone `/actions` mounts register `POST` only, so the `plugin-hono-server` adapter answers an anonymous non-`POST` `405` + `Allow: POST` before the domain's ADR-0138 D2 baseline runs; the adapter's `Allow` also lists `/keys`' refusal-only verbs | none: `createHonoApp` answers the same request `401`, and the `/keys` and `/notifications` members were closed by #23909 and #24024 | every anonymous caller of the standalone server (`os dev`, `os serve`) and every client that trusts `Allow`; measured by #24023's dev on PR #24227 (real socket, CORS on and off)
Thread-read: 6243379401
Serial constraints cleared:
- Open PRs' file lists were read in this act. Only PR #24232 (#24222, `domain:spec`) touches `dispatcher-plugin.ts`, at `readGatedSessionUser` (`:210`), which is disjoint from the mounts. No open PR touches `plugin-hono-server/src` or `domains/actions.ts`.
- Among the `pm:dispatched` claims, only #24222's names `dispatcher-plugin.ts` (that same PR). No `pm:on-hold` `Restart-touch:` names these files.
- **Fold-or-serial with #24151** (p3, `pm:queue`, this lane: 20 `req.body` sites in the same file, three of them the `/actions` mounts this card rewrites), by the five gates: gate ① fails. This card is the mounts' verb coverage and the `Allow` content. #24151 is the body read ahead of the floor, a different defect shape and a different fix. → **serial**: #24151 waits until this card lands and is re-priced then.
- PR #24227 (#24023) merged at 23:50Z, and its signed-in `405` + `Allow: POST` pin is the control.
Scope: p2, inside this seat's p1/p2/p3 scope (the maintainer, in this session's chat: 「暂时只处理 p1 p2 任务」, then 「p3 任务也可以开始处理」).
